company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech in the financial-services industry, providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. Its stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility and learning from problems, and simplifying work so it can move quickly for clients.

The company promotes career development through clear career paths, an annual learning budget and departmental mentoring. Most offices use a hybrid model, with three days a week spent together in the office; collaboration and team events are part of its culture across roughly 40 offices. Employee feedback describes a commercially driven environment with friendly colleagues, though onboarding and training can vary between teams. Its culture rating is slightly below that of similarly sized financial-services companies.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
